text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you happen to know this
drink's
slogan?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That phrase really stuck with me as a
child. Now I
feel nostalgic whenever I
have this drink.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Maybe I should get one more.
